NANDI — TINY UNIVERSAL HELPER LINEAGE v0.1

NANDI is not edenOS Core. NANDI is the tiny starter/helper product lineage for each physical domain, using edenOS Core.

DESIGN DNA
Tiny; affordable; low energy; approachable; modular payload; easy transport; local operation; simple repair; graceful degradation.

DOMAIN EXAMPLES
Nandi Ground — Roomba-sized tractor/utility helper rover.
Nandi Air — Mavic Mini-class helper aircraft concept.
Nandi Surface/Marine — compact helper surface craft.
Future domains may be added without redefining Core.

NANDI GROUND P0
Approx. 400 x 450 mm; 12 V prototype power; MCU/Core prototype; differential drive; encoders; IMU; obstacle sensing; bumper/E-stop; battery monitoring; payload/tool interface; Wi-Fi/BLE; machine bus.

FUNCTIONAL PROGRESSION
Manual → Teach → Replay → programmed rows → obstacle-safe deterministic automation → Return Home → assisted/precision navigation only when justified.

DETERMINISTIC FIELD LOOP
Manually position → enter field length/width/row spacing/speed → start → run row → turn → shift one row → return → repeat → stop.
No AI, cloud, GPS or ROS is required for this useful baseline.

DEDICATED MACHINES
Do not enlarge Nandi indefinitely. Mechanical Mule and other larger/specialist machines retain their own lineages while sharing edenOS Core architecture and compatible contracts.
